integrity.proof_basis: Direct analytic derivation from normalized radial area measure, a Taylor remainder bound, and exponential moments.

scientific_limitations: The expansion is for the specific plurisubharmonic function in the cited source and fixed \(B>0\).
No uniformity in \(B\) or extension to general plurisubharmonic functions is claimed.
The coefficient quantifies this counterexample; it is not asserted to be universal or extremal across a class.
title: Two-term upper-oscillation growth for a plurisubharmonic bidisc counterexample
